The 2026-01 contract (services.raft_role as sole leader source) is retired; readers still consuming the leader witness are migration debt tracked by the single-leadership-authority program, not license to re-open the leader lane. History: five interaction-blind fixes 2026-06..08 each perturbed this seam; this table is the interaction's owned contract (doctrine section 18). The wasm/meta lane publishes RAW roles today (no normalization is applied anywhere in src/wasm-service/); its rows are the only leadership source for meta-services until they gain an owner row.

invariants.statement: Each service type has exactly one durable leader-identity authority. For partition services it is partitions.leader_node_id (tenure-claimed, CAS-guarded, criticality-owned); for message-group services it is message_groups.leader_node_id (CAS-guarded; tenure claims and a criticality owner are program scope); services.raft_role never publishes leader for either. wasm/meta services have no owner row, so services.raft_role remains their declared authority by scoped exception until they gain one.
Collapse writes follower, never null or absence: voter-accounting gates (CL-021/CL-035 census) require a truthy voter role on every active replica row.

The role-persistence lane is the sole writer of services.raft_role for its replica (control-plane Row Ownership Matrix). A row-creation owner stamping leader into raft_role is a shadow writer; retiring that stamp is program scope and must land together with re-keying publishCanonicalLeaderNodeId off live leadership instead of the stamped row.

A reader that needs leader identity and finds services.raft_role empty of leaders migrates to the authority column; it never motivates re-enabling the leader value in the projection (the 2026-03 collapse guards deferred stale-leader claims and stays).
